'''Docking bay 33''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] that was located in [[Kwilaan Starport/Legends|Kwilaan Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the terrorist group the [[Army of Life]] parked the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Majestic Gundark]]'' in docking bay 33 and hired a group of agents to use the vessel to transport some crates of [[clodhopper]]s to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stend IV]]. The agents traveled to the bay to take control of the YT-1300, but on arrival there, they were confronted by some [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|security officers]], who suspected that the agents were involved in [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]].
